title: Polyphyllin VI induces Forkhead box O3 nuclear liquid-liquid phase separation to promote mitophagy in breast cancer.
authors: Zhan, Xiangrong; Zhong, Yifan; Liu, Xuewen; Peng, Wenkang; Zhang, Xu; Xiang, Ke; Yu, Qingqing; Chai, Yanting; Chen, Yingli; Liu, Ying; Si, Yuan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PPVI诱导FOXO3转录因子核内液-液相分离促进乳腺癌线粒体自噬，涉及TF-DNA转录激活与分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物机制而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mitochondrial dysfunction and defective mitophagy are closely associated with cancer progression. Forkhead box O3 (FOXO3), a key transcription factor, promotes autophagy by activating autophagy-related genes. Polyphyllin VI (PPVI), a Paris polyphylla-derived steroidal saponin, displays potent antitumor activity. PURPOSE: To investigate the antitumor effect of PPVI in breast cancer (BC) and elucidate its underlying mechanism. METHODS: Differential gene expression and pathway enrichment were analyzed using RNA sequencing. Mitochondrial autophagic flux was assessed using the mKeima-Red-Mito-7 plasmid. Expression of mitophagy-related markers was evaluated by qPCR and Western blot. FOXO3 was identified as a direct PPVI-binding protein using a biotin-labeled PPVI and mass spectrometry. Their interaction was validated by Microscale thermophoresis. The role of FOXO3 in PPVI-induced mitophagy was studied using gene knockout, gene/protein expression analysis, and functional assays. FOXO3-driven liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) and PPVI's regulatory role were analyzed by live-cell imaging, fluorescence recovery after photobleaching, truncation mutants, and molecular dynamics simulations. The in vivo anticancer activity of PPVI was evaluated using zebrafish and xenograft mouse models. Drug toxicity was assessed in zebrafish, while pharmacokinetics and tissue distribution were evaluated in rats. RESULTS: PPVI induced BNIP3/NIX-mediated mitophagy and mitochondrial dysfunction. It directly bound FOXO3, promoting nuclear translocation and transcriptional activation. FOXO3 underwent LLPS, mainly driven by its C2 region (151-673 aa), and PPVI enhanced the nuclear LLPS of FOXO3. PPVI suppressed tumor growth in vivo but exhibited cardiotoxicity in zebrafish. It primarily accumulated in the liver, had a short half-life, and showed extremely low oral bioavailability. CONCLUSION: PPVI exerts its anti-BC activity by directly binding FOXO3, inducing its nuclear condensation with LLPS-like properties, and thereby predominantly engages BNIP3/NIX-mediated mitophagy. These findings reveal that the antitumor effects of PPVI rely on an unrecognized critical role of FOXO3 phase behavior, establishing PPVI as a unique pharmacological probe and lead compound that functions through direct modulation of FOXO3, offering a new direction for therapeutic development.
abstract_zh: 背景：线粒体功能障碍和缺陷性线粒体自噬与癌症进展密切相关。叉头框蛋白O3（FOXO3）作为一种关键转录因子，通过激活自噬相关基因促进自噬。重楼皂苷VI（PPVI）是一种来源于重楼的甾体皂苷，具有强效抗肿瘤活性。目的：研究PPVI在乳腺癌（BC）中的抗肿瘤效应，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：利用RNA测序分析差异基因表达和通路富集。使用mKeima-Red-Mito-7质粒评估线粒体自噬流。通过qPCR和Western blot评估线粒体自噬相关标志物的表达。使用生物素标记的PPVI和质谱法鉴定FOXO3为PPVI的直接结合蛋白。通过微量热泳动验证其相互作用。利用基因敲除、基因/蛋白表达分析和功能实验研究FOXO3在PPVI诱导的线粒体自噬中的作用。通过活细胞成像、荧光漂白后恢复、截短突变体和分子动力学模拟分析FOXO3驱动的液-液相分离（LLPS）及PPVI的调控作用。使用斑马鱼和异种移植小鼠模型评估PPVI的体内抗癌活性。在斑马鱼中评估药物毒性，在大鼠中评估药代动力学和组织分布。结果：PPVI诱导BNIP3/NIX介导的线粒体自噬和线粒体功能障碍。它直接结合FOXO3，促进其核转位和转录激活。FOXO3发生LLPS，主要由其C2区域（151-673 aa）驱动，且PPVI增强FOXO3的核内LLPS。PPVI在体内抑制肿瘤生长，但在斑马鱼中表现出心脏毒性。它主要蓄积于肝脏，半衰期短，口服生物利用度极低。结论：PPVI通过直接结合FOXO3，诱导其具有LLPS样特性的核内凝聚，从而主要激活BNIP3/NIX介导的线粒体自噬，发挥其抗BC活性。这些发现揭示PPVI的抗肿瘤效应依赖于FOXO3相行为的一个未被认识的关键作用，确立PPVI作为一种独特的药理学探针和先导化合物，通过直接调控FOXO3发挥作用，为治疗开发提供新方向。
